decisions.reason: As a product line with several models on its own webpage and close to the firm's core formwork business, it reflects visible investment and commitment that management is likely to continue in a growing market.

Although less prominently presented than A or E, it is still close to the established offer and was retained on the website through 2019, so management is likely to persist unless evidence of weak demand becomes unmistakable.
Its own webpage signals a stronger public commitment and likely development effort, which under escalation of commitment makes management more inclined to keep it and justify the earlier launch.

This product appears to involve a smaller visible commitment because it was only mentioned on the website, but as it fits the core magnetic formwork range in an expanding firm, management would still be somewhat more likely to retain than withdraw it.
